question_en: List the resolutions related to changes to TS 38.211 (revision history of 38.211).
original_query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE a.content CONTAINS '38.211' RETURN a.resolutionId, m.meetingNumber, a.content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, a.resolutionId LIMIT 15
reference_query:
MATCH (resolution:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(:Spec {specNumber:'38.211'}),
      (resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(meeting:Meeting)
WITH DISTINCT resolution, meeting.meetingNumberInt AS meetingNumberInt
RETURN resolution.resolutionId AS resolutionId,
       meetingNumberInt,
       coalesce(resolution.sequence, toInteger(last(split(resolution.resolutionId,'-')))) AS sequence
ORDER BY meetingNumberInt DESC, sequence ASC, resolutionId ASC
